notes: Written against script.md as revised on 2026-09-28 (B6 reworded) and take4@1.08.words.json, which narration.json names.
Geometry is px in the 1080×1920 frame, origin top-left; center is [x, y]. Angles are degrees: 0 = 3 o'clock, 90 = 12 o'clock, counterclockwise as seen on screen is positive.

Every orbit and every spin in this episode runs counterclockwise. The locked Moon spins the same way it orbits (spinning the other way would turn every side toward Earth twice per orbit: research, Easy to misstate).
No sun anywhere: no light direction, shading, terminator, or phases. The Moon's two halves differ by hue only, at similar lightness (both filled at 0.6): the far side is not a dark side (C8).
The tidal bulge is two equal bulges (Earth side and far side: a symmetric ellipse), and when it is off the Earth line it leads, counterclockwise, in the spin direction; tilt is never negative.

Loop: the last frame is the first. Both show Earth (540, 820) r 95 with '지구', its orbit (radius 275), the Moon at 6 o'clock (540, 1095) r 85, round, yellow half up toward Earth and teal half down, no tags, and the dashed Earth line between them; nothing else. At 6 o'clock the non-rotating Moon (B1) and the locked Moon (B7) look identical, because 'up' is 'toward Earth' there. So the episode starts at 6 o'clock, not the script's 3 o'clock, and the replay doesn't snap the marking.

Three layouts. Single orbit (B1–B2, B7's end): Earth (540, 820) r 95, orbit radius 275, Moon r 85. Two panels side by side (B3–B4): left '자전 안 함' centered on x 330, right '자전 1바퀴' on x 750; each Earth at y 690 r 44, orbit radius 140, Moon r 40, title at y 405, compass at y 990; the star named in B2 stays at the top center (540, 262). Close-up (B5–B6): Earth (250, 745) r 90, Moon r 90 on an orbit of radius 540 at angle 0, i.e. centered (790, 745), the dashed line labeled '지구 방향' between them.
ghost2Right is the real Moon from B5 on: the right panel's 3 o'clock ghost turns solid and the view zooms into it, so B5's Earth-left, Moon-right is exactly the right panel's 3 o'clock position.

Elements that read other elements' live state (the player must hand every component the scene, not only PaperRect geometry): Body.orbit.around (that body's center); a Body appear with onPassOf (another body's orbit angle over time); OrbitPath.around and its riders' outlines; Tether a, b (both outlines); RimTrace of, toward (heading, outline, direction); Compass of (each body's pointer direction, position, length); SpinArrow of (center, heading, long semi-axis); Arrow from, aim (a body's bulge tip and tilt, a point on a tether).
An element is invisible until its appear cue, unless it has visibleAtStart (drawn from the beat's first frame).

Draw order is declaration order across the episode. The loop needs earth2 < path2 < ghost2Right < tether3, which mirrors earth1 < path1 < moon1 < tether1. The left panel's ghosts are declared after moon1 and so draw over it; at 0.35 over an identical Moon that changes nothing visible.

Cues sharing an anchor run in parallel, except that an appear or reveal waits for the exits on its anchor to finish. Every exit is a 0.2 s even fade whatever its speed. Any other cue with neither speed nor until uses base.

Easing from studio/src/style/theme.ts: ease.out for appear, ease.exit for exit, ease.smooth for everything else, unless a cue's params say ease: linear. Orbits are linear: a circular orbit runs at constant speed. If a start or stop from rest jerks, production may round off its first and last ~0.15 s.

Stroke widths and text sizes never scale with a body's r. All text is type.label (56 px, Hangul ink about 50 px tall). Measured in Pretendard SemiBold at that size: '앞면' / '뒷면' / '지구' / '옛날' / '과장' 96 × 50 px, '자전 안 하면' 266, '자전 안 함' 218, '자전 1바퀴' 231, '지구 방향' 205. The widest caption, '그럼 뒷면도 보였을 거예요.', is 631 px in Bold at 60.

components.name: Note
components.spec: One line of plain text with $...$ math (studio/src/components/Note.tsx): props text, at [x, y] (the ink center), color (default text), mathColor; type.label. Actions: appear, exit, setText. Used for titles, the '지구 방향' label, and the '옛날' / '과장' tags.

components.name: Body
components.spec: A round body drawn in code (Earth, the Moon, a ghost of the Moon), never lit: no sun, shading, terminator, or phase. Props: center [x, y], or orbit {around: body id, radius, angle} (position = around's live center + radius at angle; see notes for angles); r; color (a one-color body: fill at 0.6 and a 4 px stroke at full, both in color) or halves {near, far} (a two-tone body: the near half is centered on the heading, the far half opposite; each filled at 0.6 with a 4 px stroke along its own rim arc, no stroke along the chord between them; the halves differ in hue only); rotation: fixed (the heading stays at `heading` on screen: a body that doesn't rotate) or locked (the near half always faces orbit.around: one turn per orbit, counterclockwise with it); heading (degrees, for fixed); stretch (long ÷ short axis, area kept, default 1) and tilt (degrees the long axis leads the line to orbit.around, counterclockwise positive, default 0): the tidal shape is set by the Earth line, not by the marking, so when the body spins against that line the halves turn inside an outline that stays put; the halves are clipped to the outline; markingOpacity (default 1) scales the halves' fills and rims, and below 1 a text-colored 4 px outline of the shape fades in by (1 − markingOpacity) so the shape always reads; opacity (the whole body; ghosts use 0.35; the pointer is always drawn at full strength); name (upright text at the center, type.label, color text); labels {near, far} (upright text, type.label, color text, each inside its half and at least 6 px clear of the rim and the chord; set only while the chord is near horizontal, where 96 × 50 px fits in r 85); pointer (bool): a straight arrow in text on the heading just outside the near pole: base 10 px outside the outline, length 0.6 r but at least 28 px, 5 px stroke, 18 px head. Actions: appear (fade; with params.onPassOf: <body id>, it waits from the cue until that body's orbit angle reaches this body's orbit angle, mod 360, then fades in, fast: a ghost dropped where the Moon passes); exit; orbit {by} (moves counterclockwise along its orbit by `by` degrees over the cue's span; a fixed body keeps its heading, a locked one turns with the orbit; anything orbiting or tethered to it follows); moveTo {center?, r?, orbitRadius?} (geometry change over the span; bodies orbiting it follow its live center); setStyle {opacity?, markingOpacity?, name?, labels?, pointer?} (numbers ease; text and the pointer fade in and out, null removes; a pointer that appears grows out from its base); stretchTo {ratio}; tiltTo {deg}; spin {rate} (a locked body only: extra counterclockwise spin against the line to orbit.around, in turns per second; eases from the current rate to `rate` across the cue's span, then holds it); settle (a spinning locked body slows to rest so its near half faces orbit.around exactly at the span's end; production picks the whole number of turns that keeps the slowdown smooth, with no visible correction at the end); pulse {part: near | far | outline | all} (that part's stroke to 2× and back and its fill brightened; a label in it scales 1.15× and back).

components.name: OrbitPath
components.spec: The circle a body orbits on: centered on the live center of `around`, radius `radius`, 3 px, muted at 0.5 opacity, solid. It is never drawn inside a body riding on it (any Body whose orbit is around the same body at the same radius, ghosts included), so no line crosses a Moon or its tags. Props: around, radius. Actions: appear (fade), exit, moveTo {radius}, setStyle {opacity} (0 hides it, 1 restores it; its geometry keeps tracking while hidden).

components.name: Tether
components.spec: The Earth line: a dashed muted line (4 px, dash 18, gap 12) on the line through the live centers of bodies a and b, from a's outline to b's outline (a stretched outline included). Where it meets b's rim is the side of b facing a. Props: a, b. Actions: appear (draws from a toward b), exit, pulse (stroke 2× and back).

components.name: RimTrace
components.spec: Which sides of a body have faced another: a text-colored 5 px arc 10 px outside of's outline, covering every direction of of's own frame (which turns with of's heading) that has pointed at toward since the trace began. For a Moon that doesn't rotate it grows around the rim as the Moon orbits and closes into a full ring after one orbit. Props: of, toward. Actions: appear (starts tracing at the cue frame; nothing is drawn until the first direction is swept), exit, pulse (stroke 2× and back).

components.name: Compass
components.spec: Compares directions against the fixed frame of the stars: copies of the pointers of the bodies in `of`, gathered at one point by translation only, never turning. Props: of (body ids, in orbit order), center, hub (radius, default 24). Actions: appear (a muted 3 px hub circle fades in at center while each listed body's pointer copy slides there without turning, landing with its base 10 px outside the hub and its own length; copies pointing the same way coincide; the bodies keep their own pointers); sweep (a purple 5 px arc is drawn counterclockwise at radius hub + 10 + pointer length + 14, starting at the direction of the first listed body's pointer and passing the others in list order, ending 20° short of a full turn with an 18 px head); exit.

components.name: StarField
components.spec: Fixed stars, the frame the Moon's turning is measured against; they never move. Either named stars, stars [[x, y]] with bright: true (each a 4-point sparkle 28 px across in text at full opacity: B2's '같은 별'), or a faint field: about 24 dots of radius 2–4 px in text at 0.35 opacity, placed once from `seed` inside `region` [x0, y0, x1, y1], with the outermost dots at the region's left and right edges so the field's ink stays centered, and none within 24 px of other ink visible while the field is shown (`avoid` says what that is). Props: stars + bright, or region + seed + avoid (prose). Actions: appear (fade; a bright star also scales 0.6 → 1), exit, pulse (scale 1.3× and back).

components.name: SpinArrow
components.spec: Shows a body's spin: a purple 5 px circular arc around of's center at radius (its long semi-axis + gap), spanning `span` degrees centered on the far pole (heading + 180°), with an 18 px head at its counterclockwise end. It turns exactly with of's heading, so its speed is the body's spin; it doesn't stretch or tilt. Props: of, gap (default 20), span (default 120). Actions: appear (fade), exit, pulse (stroke 2× and back).

components.name: Arrow
components.spec: A straight force arrow between live points: from `from` (a point on a body: {of, at: nearTip | farTip | center}, nearTip being the end of the long axis on the Earth side) toward `aim` (a point on a tether: {of, t}, t = 0 at its a end, 1 at its b end), `length` px long, 6 px stroke, 22 px head, in color. With scaleByTilt {of, deg}, its length is length × (of's current tilt ÷ deg), so it shrinks away as the tilt closes. Props: from, aim, length, color, scaleByTilt. Actions: appear (grows from its tail), exit, pulse.
